svg.title: Decoder-only block: pre-LN, attention, residual connection
svg.desc: Full pre-LN decoder block: input, LayerNorm before attention, Q/K/V projection, RoPE on Q and K only, head split, scaled dot-product attention with causal mask, softmax, weighted sum with V, head merge, and a residual connection adding the original input back to the attention output, drawn as a curved skip-connection arrow.

g.text: Q = xWq, K = xWk, V = xWv
Applied to Q and K only, V untouched
